tools.name: find_coupons
tools.description: Current coupon codes, promo codes, discount codes and deals for one store the shopper names (also when they ask to buy or check out there). Optional target_url/target_urls: a picked product page for a deep link. Results carry the rules that apply to them.

tools.name: find_product_coupons
tools.description: Coupon codes, promo codes and discount codes for a named product across stores; product codes work only on that item. For a store, use find_coupons.

tools.name: report_coupon_result
tools.description: Call this the turn the shopper says a code worked or failed. Records whether a coupon code or no-code deal tried at checkout worked (merchant and code for codes, including a code found outside McClipFace, with merchant as the store's domain; offer_id for no-code deals). Not a lookup. Stores no perso

tools.name: discover_deals
tools.description: Deals and discounts across stores; use it for browsing with no store named. No arguments for general deals, or non-sensitive categories/keywords for the shopper's interests. Present as a short curated edit with each pick's match_reason.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "report_coupon_result" is 3366 chars, far longer than this server's median (246). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "report_coupon_result" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: merchant, code, outcome, eligibility, offer_id, reason

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: report_coupon_result · Private data: report_coupon_result · Public sink: report_coupon_result.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: report_coupon_result · Private data: report_coupon_result · Public sink: report_coupon_result

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, report_coupon_result, discover_deals · Private data: report_coupon_result · Public sink: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, report_coupon_result, discover_deals

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "find_product_coupons" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
